description: Test suite for Custom Profile Attributes API in Mattermost, including creation, listing, patching, deletion of CPA fields and values, with license and permission checks, websocket event verification, and validation of LDAP/SAML constraints.

methods.name: TestCreateCPAField
methods.description: Tests creation of CPA fields, license validation, permission checks, websocket event firing, and attribute sanitization.

methods.name: TestListCPAFields
methods.description: Tests listing of CPA fields with license validation and filtering of deleted fields.

methods.name: TestPatchCPAField
methods.description: Tests patching of CPA fields, including validation, sanitization, websocket events, and attribute management.

methods.name: TestDeleteCPAField
methods.description: Tests deletion of CPA fields with license validation, permission checks, and websocket event firing.

methods.name: TestListCPAValues
methods.description: Tests listing of CPA values with license validation, permission checks, and handling of array and LDAP/SAML constraints.

methods.name: TestPatchCPAValues
methods.description: Tests patching of CPA values, including validation, sanitization, permission checks, LDAP/SAML constraints, and batch operations.

methods.name: TestPatchCPAValuesForUser
methods.description: Tests user-specific CPA value patching with license validation, permission checks, websocket events, and validation.
